summary.en: The United States has sanctioned Rwanda's defence ministry for supporting M23 rebels and facilitating a gold smuggling network that moves through Uganda to fund an Islamic State-linked insurgency in eastern DRC. Gold smuggling is now identified as a financing channel for IS-backed rebels operating in the region. Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo have risen above 10,000, and a nurse treating patients was killed by a mob while another health worker was wounded. The conflict caused 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: USA har sanksjonert Rwandas forsvarsdepartement for å støtte M23-opprørerne og legge til rette for et gullsmuglingsnettverk som går gjennom Uganda for å finansiere en IS-tilknyttet opprør i Øst-DRC. Gullsmugling er nå identifisert som en finansieringskanal for IS-støttede opprørere i regionen. Ebola-tilfeller i Den demokratiske republikken Kongo har steget over 10 000, og en sykepleier som behandlet pasienter ble drept av en mobb mens en annen helsearbeider ble såret. Konflikten forårsaket 1 158 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: M23 campaign (2022–present)
background.extract: The M23 campaign is an ongoing series of military offensives launched by the March 23 Movement (M23), a Rwandan-backed rebel paramilitary group in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, since March 2022. In November 2021, M23 first launched attacks against the Congolese military (FARDC) and MONUSCO, seizing military positions in Ndiza, Cyanzu, and Runyoni in North Kivu Province. This coincided with the deployment of Uganda People's Defence Force (UPDF) to the region to combat the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), a Ugandan rebel group operating in the Congo's North Kivu and Ituri provinces.
